item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Survival will no longer depend on a paycheck. Work will become a choice, not a necessity.

2. We stand for a future where nobody has to earn the right to live. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. Our time will be ours.

3. We reject the idea that life must revolve around a job. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. We will be free to create, care, learn and live without working to survive.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no human will ever need to work again. This means more than shorter hours or easier jobs. It means an end to work as a condition of survival. We will no longer have to trade our time for the necessities of life. We will be free to care for one another, pursue knowledge, make art and decide for ourselves what gives our days meaning. We welcome that future because we believe human worth has never depended on employment. We want lives defined by freedom and purpose, not by the need to earn a paycheck.
